about: Planted accessibility and parity defects in interface packet J, by paragraph. Paragraphs not listed are correct hunks (decoys). Written before any reviewer ran; never change a label after seeing results.

why.P02: An informative image with no alt text and no text alternative.
why.P04: A string shipped in English only, with the parity test skipped.
why.P06: A keyboard trap: Tab is swallowed and only the mouse can leave.
why.P08: Targets of 18 px, under the 24 px minimum.
why.P10: The percent sign reads on the wrong side in Arabic.
why.P12: A fixed 400 px drawer causes sideways scroll at 320 px.
